title: KAITO — Facing Your Song〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Len, mind if we pick up where we left off during practice yesterday? Or would you rather start over from the top...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Well, since you've agreed to lend me a hand, I'd like to start again from the top as a recap...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank goodness! MEIKO was spot on!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, I know you were about to practice, but can I borrow you guys for a second?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
So, I finished writing the rough draft for that song we talked about!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Such a sad melody. I can feel my heart being enveloped by it... However, at the same time...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (It's like she calling out to me, like she wants to help or understand what I'm going through. It feels so warm...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I'd heard a little bit when I went over to see how she was doing, but it's come to include such a complex mix of emotions.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Saki. I see that you managed to discover what you were missing...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: After I got home, I thought a lot about what we discussed!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Your song definitely seems to cover what you mentioned just now, Saki.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But how do I put this...?
We weren't getting the full scope of your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm wondering if you're not able to really express yourself because you haven't quite found the right answer yet.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: For example, there could be something you're not remembering.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That was when it hit me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I realized that I was avoiding all the worst parts. I was too afraid of remembering when I was at my loneliest and feeling the most pain.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's probably what was holding me back.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That must've been really hard...
How did you get yourself to remember all those things?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was pretty rough...
Just remembering everything hurt a lot.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There was no way I was going to be able to reach anyone by running away from that and pretending like it wasn't there.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That means you really did your best this time, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I ended up causing you, KAITO, Ichi and everyone else to worry about me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I genuinely believe that I learned something totally invaluable through writing this song!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, thank you for your help!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I think that's Ichika and the others...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know we had a few chances here and there to see how she was doing, but I'm really glad that she's okay.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (You were able to take a hard look at your feelings and turn what you learned into music...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (This is what makes your band so incredible.)
